title: Front Mount Aluminum Intercooler (27" x 7" x 2.5", 2.5" Inlet/Outlet)
description: Built to drop intake temperatures and increase air charge density without strangling airflow, this universal front-mount intercooler is rated for builds up to 350–400 horsepower. Featuring a lightweight 21x7x2.25-inch tube-and-fin core with TIG-welded T6061 cast aluminum end tanks, it flows under 350 CFM while keeping pressure drops minimal—losing only 0.2 to 0.5 PSI at 15 PSI of boost. The 2.5-inch inlet and outlet connections allow easy integration into most custom 4-cylinder and smaller 6-cylinder piping layouts, safely handling boost pressures up to 30+ PSI. It provides a reliable thermal barrier against heat soak during repeated high-load pulls without creating excessive drag on your turbo's compressor response.
